fields.description: Program Description Academic Year & Curriculum This is a 5-year program, 3 trimesters per academic year. Curriculum (280 Credits) Compulsory Courses · Normal Human Anatomy · TCM Basic Theory · Basic Chinese Language · Basics of Chemistry · Healthcare Physical Education · Biochemistry · Tuina Exercise · Meridians and Points · Overview of China · Microbiology · Guidance for Humanity Social Practice · Case Studies · TCM Diagnostics · Chinese Materia Medica · Physiology · Intermediate-level Chinese Language · Formulas of Chinese Herbal Medicine · Introduction to TCM Classics · Basics of Pathology · Acupuncture and Moxibustion Technique · Theory of Tuina Manipulations · Pharmacology · Basics of Diagnostics · TCM Internal Medicine · Clinical Conversations in Traditional Chinese Medicine · Tuina Practice on Human Body · Radiology · Acupuncture and Moxibustion Technique · Internal Medicine · Anatomy of Acupuncture Points · Medical Terminologies · Selective Readings of Acupuncture Classics · History of Chinese Medicine · Practice of Acupuncture and Moxibustion Techniques · Overview on TCM-Style Writing · Tuina Therapeutics · Acupuncture Therapeutics · TCM Traumatology · Medical Ethics · General Introduction to Rehabilitation · Neurology · TCM Emergencies · Clinical Psychology Teaching Methods These include classroom lectures, group discussions, bedside teaching, simulated demonstration, practical training and social practice. The teaching will highlight the training on students’ self-learning ability. Most lectures will take place in the Zhangjiang Campus, most clinical internship and probation will take place in the affiliated hospitals. Graduation and Academic Degree A Bachelor of Chinese Medicine will be awarded upon completion of · Required credits of all courses in the teaching scheme · General points average (GPA) · Pass of all examinations Type of class Independent class with at least 5 students

CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements High school graduation or higher education background. Requirements for English language. (a)Studied courses taught in English language and transcripts required. (b)>90 of TOEFL or >6 of IELTS (non-native English speakers). Applicants emigrating from mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao or Taiwan must hold a valid foreign citizenship for no less than 4 years and a record of residency in the country for no less than 2 years in the most recent 4 years. Under 65 years of age; exceptions can be considered for applicants with competitive academic background or those recommended by collaborative universities.
